type.description: Script type. Possible values: 0 - Script; 1 - IPMI; 2 - SSH; 3 - Telnet; 5 - (default) Webhook.

scope.description: Script scope. Possible values: 1 - (default) action operation; 2 - manual host action; 4 - manual event action.

execute_on.description: Where to run the script. Used if type is 0 (script). Possible values: 0 - run on Zabbix agent; 1 - run on Zabbix server; 2 - (default) run on Zabbix server (proxy).

menu_path.description: Folders separated by slash that form a menu like navigation in frontend when clicked on host or event. Used if scope is 2 or 4.

authtype.description: Authentication method used for SSH script type. Used if type is 2. Possible values: 0 - password; 1 - public key.

username.description: User name used for authentication. Required if type is 2 or 3.

password.description: Password used for SSH scripts with password authentication and Telnet scripts. Used if type is 2 and authtype is 0, or type is 3.

publickey.description: Name of the public key file used for SSH scripts with public key authentication. Required if type is 2 and authtype is 1.

privatekey.description: Name of the private key file used for SSH scripts with public key authentication. Required if type is 2 and authtype is 1.

port.description: Port number used for SSH and Telnet scripts. Used if type is 2 or 3.

groupid.description: ID of the host group that the script can be run on. If set to 0, the script will be available on all host groups. Default: 0.

usrgrpid.description: ID of the user group that will be allowed to run the script. If set to 0, the script will be available for all user groups. Used if scope is 2 or 4. Default: 0.

host_access.description: Host permissions needed to run the script. Used if scope is 2 or 4. Possible values: 2 - (default) read; 3 - write.

confirmation.description: Confirmation pop up text. The pop up will appear when trying to run the script from the Zabbix frontend. Used if scope is 2 or 4.

timeout.description: Webhook script execution timeout in seconds. Time suffixes are supported, e.g. 30s, 1m. Required if type is 5. Possible values: 1-60s. Default value: 30s.

parameters.description: Array of webhook input parameters. Used if type is 5.
